description: Defines event handler delegates and event argument class for gateway count change events in Orleans, including information about connection state and change detection.

classes.name: GatewayCountChangedEventArgs
classes.description: Event arguments class that encapsulates the current and previous number of connected gateways, and indicates if a connection was recovered.

methods.name: GatewayCountChangedEventArgs
methods.description: Constructor initializing the event args with current and previous gateway counts.
